correctness.rationale: All 2^16 BWT block orientations are covered by the explicit LF inverse permutation; the single-32-cycle criterion is necessary and sufficient for binary order-five de Bruijn words. A separate rooted Euler-edge enumeration returns exactly the same 2048 canonical words with identical run counts, after independent BWT sorting. Formula r=17+count_equal_adjacencies and smaller-order bound tests are proved and checked. The standalone verify.py reproduces all counts.

value.rationale: BWT run count is the natural run-length compression statistic. The first order where the universal binary de Bruijn lower bound m+2 is not attained marks a concrete structural boundary. A complete 2048-cycle six-point frequency distribution and exact number of min-run extremizers form a motivated, finite, complete classification; not a random slice of an unmotivated invariant.
